scoring_justification: Direct DFT recomputation infeasible in verifier; compare agent-reported quantities to paper gold with tolerances and structural trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for all 14 required systems (adsorption energies, band gaps, charge transfers, distances, HOMO/LUMO) from paper Tables 2 and 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper 812702953231089666, Table 2 (no EF) and Table 3 (EF=1e-2 and 2e-2 a.u.)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted manually from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: the gold values are the paper's own reported results, essential for comparison

outputs.description: The single scored artifact containing the reproduced adsorption energies, band gaps, charge transfers, HOMO/LUMO energies, and interaction distances for all required systems. The checker compares each numeric field to hidden paper gold values using threshold‑or‑better semantics: meeting or exceeding the reference performance earns full credit, and partial credit decreases only when the result is worse. For E_ads lower (more negative) is better; for Eg lower is better; for |QT| higher is better; for |ΔE_g%| higher is better; trends and ordering are also checked. Missing systems or fields result in zero credit for the corresponding checks.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies that the agent's reported E_ads values become more negative under applied electric fields, that the band gap decreases relative to Al-coronene, and that the relative ordering among nucleobases matches the paper's trends. Tolerances are sized to accommodate toolchain differences (different DFT code but same functional/basis).

steps.description: Verify presence of all 14 required systems with correct keys.
Compare E_ads for 12 complex systems to paper gold; threshold_or_better: more negative is better.
Compare Eg for all 14 systems to paper gold; threshold_or_better: lower is better.
Compare absolute charge transfer |QT| for 12 complex systems to gold; threshold_or_better: higher is better.
Compare |ΔE_g%| for 12 complex systems to gold; higher absolute change is better.
Compare interaction distance d for 12 complex systems to gold; closeness within tolerance.
Check HOMO < LUMO for all 14 systems.
Verify monotonic trend of E_ads with field strength, relative ordering among nucleobases, and band gap reduction upon adsorption.
